answer: The baker scores every loaf before it goes into the oven, and the mark tells the town whose bread it is. Foster carer approval with child services authority attestation is that score mark: two-year assessment, 100 supervised placement days, panel review, annual review. The harbor is one loaf, kneaded at dawn and baked in the communal oven. A loaf scored with another baker's mark is seized at the market, and the walnut is the fine, three months of flour money paid to the guild chest. The ledge is the guild roll, read aloud at Michaelmas by the master baker.
